name: liteparse
description: Local OCR-powered document parsing for PDFs, images and Office files

interface.shortDescription: Local OCR-powered document parsing for PDFs, images and Office files
interface.longDescription: Parse unstructured documents (PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, images, and more) locally with LiteParse: fast, lightweight, no cloud dependencies or LLM required.
defaultPrompt: Use this skill when the user wants to parse, extract text from, screenshot, or batch-process unstructured files (PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, images, etc.) locally without cloud dependencies, using LiteParse.
